supporting_evidence: Existing runtime ownership invariant requires one owner and one location.
All implemented owned-location transitions store owner identity in both OwnerId and LocationId.
Room and corpse transitions explicitly clear owner identity.
Equipment transitions require a legal slot; carrying is the only safe fallback when that slot is absent.
assumptions: Persisted OwnerId is authoritative for owned locations.
LocationKind is authoritative for room and corpse records.
fallback: Reject states that remain ambiguous or invalid after narrow normalization.
runtime_impact: Adds explicit deterministic reconciliation operation only; normal runtime mutation rules are unchanged.
character_save_impact: May recover owned items to carried inventory when an equipment slot is missing.
world_state_impact: May clear stale owners from room/corpse records and normalize owned location IDs.
